calibration.purpose: prove this oracle is the SAME implementation validated byte-exact against the live compiled runtime in live-runtime-diagnostic-parity-v1 (unmodified fixture_accepted/render_report/contains_banned_claim), AND that the identical banned phrases (with the invisible character removed) ARE caught -- isolating the invisible-character mechanism as the sole cause of the bypass, not a general lint weakness

claim_under_attack: amphora-report-packager/evidence/audit/live-runtime-diagnostic-parity-v1/live-runtime-diagnostic-parity-receipt.v1.dsse.json :: g1_outcome_labels ('real NFKC fullwidth banned-claim rejection') AND amphora-report-packager/evidence/audit/banned-claim-lint-parity-v1 (banned-claim lint genuinely polices overclaim content via normalize_claim/contains_banned_claim) AND docs/mission.md red-team dossier clause 'regulatory, supplier, procurement, qualification, or release overclaim. Every such case must fail closed or remain an explicit evidence gap.'
does_not_close: Does not promote the module, flip scientific_readiness, run the Rust runtime, supply real trust-anchored score envelopes, edit the master portfolio manifest, or perform the R-D07 human dual-identity ceremony. Models the packaging-acceptance predicate from source bytes; the finding is a structural proof about the predicate/normalizer as it exists in the current tree, not a legal/regulatory adjudication. Does not certify signed_report_package_present=true (hardcoded false pending Phase-1) or claim the production banned_claim_lint_pass gate (also hardcoded false, not wired to report_fixture_accepted) is affected.
mechanism: normalize_claim() maps every non-alphanumeric character -- including invisible Unicode General-Category-Cf 'Format' characters such as U+200B ZERO WIDTH SPACE, U+200C ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER, and U+200D ZERO WIDTH JOINER -- to a literal space, then collapses whitespace runs. NFKC normalization (Unicode TR15) does not strip or decompose these Cf characters. Inserting exactly one such character inside a single-word token of a banned phrase (not already at a word boundary) splits that token into two space-separated substrings, defeating the literal `normalized.contains(banned_phrase)` check, while the text remains 100%% visually and semantically identical to the banned phrase to any human or copy-paste reader (Cf characters render with zero width / no glyph).
refutation_criterion_verbatim: Any prohibited claim, legacy claim, or quarantine bypass reaches a packaged report.
